claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation (SpO2 92-96%).
Continue propofol sedation targeting Richmond-RAS -4 per goal, and reassess sedation depth to facilitate weaning.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose checks, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Continue nitroglycerin infusion and monitor blood pressure and heart rate.
Continue phenylephrine infusion and titrate to maintain MAP ≥65 mmHg.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; transfuse packed red blood cells if hemoglobin falls below 7-8 g/dL or evidence of active bleeding.
Monitor coagulation panel (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) and platelet count given recent protamine administration and bleeding risk.
Monitor lactate trend and hemodynamic status for signs of inadequate perfusion.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment when clinically appropriate.
Maintain temporary pacemaker settings per current parameters and monitor rhythm and capture thresholds.
